extension.summary: Listen to the audiobooks on your Audiobookshelf server
extension.description: Browse your Audiobookshelf library from the couch: Continue Listening, Recently Added, all books, series in reading order, authors and search, with cover art and progress on every book. Books play in Kodi's own player, resume where you left off on any device, start from any chapter, and report your listening progress back to the server while you listen. Needs an Audiobookshelf server and an API key.
extension.disclaimer: Not affiliated with the Audiobookshelf project. Your server address and API key are stored in Kodi's add-on settings on this device.
